meta.title: About Us - GlobalVolunteers
meta.description: Learn about GlobalVolunteers, our mission, goals, and impact around the world.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: Our mission is to connect caring people with those who need help, creating a culture of global volunteering and helping to solve social problems in different parts of the planet.

goal.title: Goal
goal.description: To create the world's largest network of volunteers and organizations ready to collaborate, and to implement at least 1000 international projects by 2025 in the fields of medicine, education, sports and ecology.

uniqueness.title: Uniqueness
uniqueness.description: We offer comprehensive support for volunteers at all stages, from selecting a project to returning home, ensuring safety, support and the opportunity to maximize their potential.

history.title: Our History
history.paragraph1: GlobalVolunteers was founded in 2015 by a group of international humanitarian workers who recognized the need for a coordinated approach to volunteer placement around the world.
history.paragraph2: What began as a small initiative with just 10 volunteers and 3 projects has grown into a global organization connecting thousands of volunteers with meaningful projects in over 30 countries.
history.paragraph3: Today, we continue to expand our reach and impact, focusing on sustainable development and building lasting partnerships with local communities and organizations.

achievement1.title: Award-Winning Volunteer Programs
achievement1.description: Our medical volunteer program was recognized with the International Humanitarian Award in 2022.

achievement2.title: Sustainable Community Development
achievement2.description: Our programs have helped establish 50+ sustainable community initiatives that continue to thrive after our direct involvement ends.

achievement3.title: Global Partnership Network
achievement3.description: We've built a network of over 200 partner organizations across 6 continents.
